ordered_effect_composition: Entry gate: win_IsWinOpen(0x0100) is called by the target; on a valid open window it returns open status, while the exact helper can clear a stale invalid handle. If closed, or if g_298E!=0 after an open result, the target returns without entering clip/render code.

Draw path call order is clip_Push(); clip_SetWin(0x0100); construct fd_50F6_38C2 in top,bottom,left,right write order; GRectInvOutline(&fd_50F6_38C2,2); set g_298E=1; clip_Pop(). clip_SetWin masks the id to 0x0100 and internally calls f_1E57_0009 before selecting the window clip list.

clip_Push measures the currently active list through its top==0x8000 sentinel, copies the list including sentinel into a size+8 allocation when present, and saves previous stack head and active pointer in node[0]/node[1]. It advances the stack head and depth. Allocation goes through exact f_171C_1A9E -> f_171C_125C -> f_171C_0EEA/f_171C_0A5C/f_171C_068C; f_171C_0EEA also has a conditional call to separately BEHAVIOR_EXACT-registered f_171C_0CF4 and f_171C_0ADC on its compaction path, detailed in registered_behavior_dependencies. Lock/data access and unlock use f_171C_1B84 -> f_171C_1FC2 and f_171C_1BBA -> f_171C_2086.

clip_SetWin masks the handle to its high-byte window id, calls exact win_IsWinOpen, selects fd_50F6_3B60[win>>8], locks the handle and copies its sentinel-terminated Rect list to fd_50F6_3C14; this fixed buffer becomes g_5AAC. Closed window selects null; open-with-null clip punts. The list pointer and contents remain runtime input state, but every access/copy/lock operation in this helper is statically composed.

GRectInvOutline forwards Rect fields and width 2 to f_1CE2_032B. That helper calls g_913C in this exact order: top horizontal strip (left+2,top+2,right-2,top); bottom horizontal (left+2,bottom-2,right-2,bottom); left vertical (left+2,top,left,bottom); right vertical (right,top,right-2,bottom).

clip_Pop begins with f_1E57_0009 cleanup of any earlier popped handle, makes the current stack node the pending popped handle, restores previous stack head and prior clip presence/list contents; for a non-null saved list, it copies node+2 into the shared active buffer rather than restoring the old pointer identity, decrements depth, and unlocks the node. f_1E57_0009 eventually disposes the pending handle through f_171C_1C0A -> f_171C_13E4 -> f_171C_1246, with exact lock/type/free helpers pinned above.

persistent_clip_globals: g_5742: pending popped clip handle; f_1E57_0009 disposes it through f_171C_1C0A and clears it.
g_5746: selected per-window clip handle; cleanup clears it, then clip_SetWin assigns the selected list handle.

g_5AAC: active near-held far Rect pointer; cleanup clears it; SetWin selects copied window list or null; Pop restores prior presence and, if nonnull, saved list contents through shared buffer fd_50F6_3C14.
fd_50F6_3B5C: clip stack head; Push links its new node and Pop restores node[0].
g_5756: clip stack depth; Push increments and Pop decrements.

clip_state_effects.ordered_clip_node_layout: Allocated size is list byte size+8. node[0] stores previous fd_50F6_3B5C; node[1] stores prior g_5AAC pointer/null marker; node+2 stores the copied sentinel-terminated Rect list. Pop tests node[1] for nullness and restores copied bytes from node+2; old pointer identity is not reinstated.
clip_state_effects.normal_preconditions: Window/clip state is caller-valid, active list pointers reference accessible far memory ending in top==0x8000, clip depth is valid (<=20 before push and >0 before pop), and clip node allocations/locks succeed under the separately registered valid-live-heap domain.
clip_state_effects.error_paths: clip_Push calls Punt on null allocation and after depth exceeds 20; clip_SetWin calls Punt if a window reports open but its clip handle is null; clip_Pop calls Punt at depth zero. The C sequence continues after Punt if it returns; the registered helper contracts exclude terminal Punt/invalid-state paths, so no noreturn assumption is made.
